Experiment Series

Code to run multiple experiments consequtively in series.

Basic setup: Everything else is kept at default values except for one variable. X_o is sampled from the true distribution. Select which parameters to sweep in main() by uncommenting or adding items to the dict. Run series by:

python experiment_series.py

Use utils.read_and_plot() for plotting.

experiment_series.main()[source]
